titleZh: 联合国可持续发展学习平台（UN SDG Learn）
summaryZh: 由联合国系统主导，提供有关 Agenda 2030、17 项可持续发展目标 (SDG) 的微学习、路径式课程及能力测评。
summaryEn: Led by the United Nations system, the platform offers micro-learning, learning pathways and competency assessments related to Agenda 2030 and the 17 Sustainable Development Goals (SDGs).

summaryZh: 提供 50+ 个免费 MOOC，聚焦可持续发展目标（SDG）议题，从全球发展、制度、政策到行业专题皆有覆盖。
summaryEn: Offers 50+ free MOOCs focusing on Sustainable Development Goals (SDGs), covering global development, institutions, policy and industry-specific topics.

titleZh: 联合国全球契约学院（UN Global Compact Academy）
summaryZh: 联合国全球契约组织的学习平台，聚焦企业可持续发展策略与 ESG 议题，从初学者到高级课程均有。
summaryEn: The learning platform of the UN Global Compact, focusing on corporate sustainability strategies and ESG topics, offering content from beginner to advanced levels.

titleZh: 联合国气候变化学习平台（UN CC Learn）
summaryZh: 联合国气候变化学习平台，专攻气候变化议题，提供自主节奏在线课程，并与联合国体系挂钩。
summaryEn: The UN climate change learning platform, offering self-paced online courses linked to the UN system, specializing in climate change topics.

summaryZh: 提供自主节奏、自付费的 ESG、净零、循环经济等线上培训，适合专业人士提升实操能力。
summaryEn: Provides self-paced, paid online training on ESG, net-zero, circular economy and related practical competencies for professionals.

titleZh: 国际金融公司（IFC）ESG 学习资源
summaryZh: 提供免费公开的 ESG、环境社会风险管理以及金融机构可持续能力建设工具。
summaryEn: Offers free, open ESG/environmental and social risk management resources and sustainability capacity-building tools for financial institutions.

titleZh: 英国开放大学 OpenLearn — 自然与环境免费课程
summaryZh: 英国开放大学免费提供的环境与可持续主题课程。
summaryEn: Free environment and sustainability-themed courses offered by The Open University.

titleZh: 麻省理工开放课件 — 环境与可持续发展课程合集
summaryZh: 麻省理工开放课件免费开放环境、可持续发展相关课程内容。
summaryEn: A freely accessible collection of MIT course materials focusing on environment and sustainability topics.

titleZh: 联合国系统职员学院（UN SSC）“可持续生活方式”课程
summaryZh: 专注于从日常生活方式维度探讨可持续发展议题的课程。
summaryEn: A course focusing on sustainable development from the perspective of daily lifestyles.

titleZh: 联合国系统职员学院（UN SSC）2025–2026 年免费课程目录
summaryZh: 2025–26 年免费课程目录可供下载，涵盖气候、和平建设、人权等主题，可用于持续追踪学习资源。
summaryEn: Downloadable catalogue of free courses for 2025–2026, covering climate, peacebuilding, human rights and other topics, useful for continuous resource tracking.

titleZh: Alison —《ESG 绩效衡量指南》课程
titleEn: Alison – “A Guide to ESG Performance Measurement”
summaryZh: 免费线上课程，专门讲解 ESG 报告标准和绩效测量方法。
summaryEn: A free online course dedicated to explaining ESG reporting standards and performance measurement.
